body.x: Netblue will showcase CoTras, a program to helpcognitive training depending on age and symptoms, at CES 2019, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8, 2019 toJanuary 11 (Fri) .

Netblue is a company that develops a computerizedcognitive rehabilitation training system. Since its establishment in 1999,Netblue has been working hard to develop the best quality, new ideas. Netblue'sCoTras is an acronym for Cognitive Training System. It is a program that can beused by children from mild to severe cognitive disabilities. From cognitiveassessment to dementia, it is possible to train by cognitive domain, and it isequipped with integrated PC training, group type / individual trainingequipment.

CoTras has the largest contents in Korea and has thefeature where it can be combined with background through augmented realitywithout chroma key. Netblue aims to advance into the US, Europe and emergingmarkets of Southeast Asia based on the strengths of CoTras.

Currently, Netblue's CoTras has been delivered tomore than 60 public health centers in Korea, and sales are also growing inhospitals and nursing homes in each region. In addition, the company'schildren's products are being actively used by children's development centersin various cities. Netblue plans to sell and lease 300 programs, including publichealth centers and hospitals, by 2018. Based on this plan, Netblue plans toopen to overseas cognitive institutions and companies.

Netblue plans to update and add new content toCoTras each year, which will broaden its range of businesses.
